name: USDU Finance
oneLiner: USDU is USDU Finance's DAO-minted dollar backed by Morpho and Curve vault shares after a sharp supply wind-down.
collateral: Adapter-held positions: Curve USDU/USDC LP tokens, Morpho USDU Core vault shares (curated lending), and TermMax USDU vault shares (fixed-term lending) as on-chain backing
pegMechanism: Protocol-minted via DAO-approved adapters; convertible to USDC via Curve pools

sources.label: USDU Finance transparency and governance disclosure
Ethereum Blockscout verified USDU Stablecoin source and ABI

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535640, the sole tracked USDU token returned curator=0x9fe66037c44236c87D9Ac8345F489b4413fDFf06, guardian=zero, timelock=604800 seconds, and no pending role or timelock change. Its verified source makes setFreeze(account, message) curator-only and immediately records the account timestamp; the ERC-20 _update hook then rejects transfers from a frozen sender. An eth_call simulation of setFreeze from the current curator succeeded without broadcasting state, while the same call from an unprivileged address reverted; a normal transfer simulation from a funded holder currently returned true. The curator is an EIP-1967 Aragon DAO proxy, so its governance is an additional control layer, but no delayed parameter change is needed for the current curator to freeze a holder. The issuer transparency page independently states that the curator can freeze specific USDU accounts. Inherited USDC backing remains a separate reserve exposure and is not the basis for this direct-token result.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

notices.title: Post-wind-down collateral coverage
notices.message: USDU Finance's transparency page currently reports roughly 100% collateralization after a sharp supply wind-down, with backing concentrated in Morpho USDU Core vault shares and Curve USDU/USDC LP tokens.

notices.title: Conflicting issuer disclosures
notices.message: USDU Finance's live transparency endpoint now reports backing approximately equal to circulating supply after the wind-down. Treat exact collateralization and allocation figures as live-snapshot values because supply and adapter balances have moved materially.

mintAuthority.summary: USDU cannot be minted by users directly; only DAO-approved/whitelisted adapter contracts (Curve, TermMax, Morpho) can mint or burn USDU, and the set of approved adapters is curated under USDU Finance DAO risk governance.

controls.label: Whitelisted USDU adapters (Curve / TermMax / Morpho)
controls.evidence: 2026-07-20 full SetModule/SubmitModule event enumeration from block 0 on the USDU token 0xdde3ec717f220fc6a29d6a4be73f91da5b718e55: 9 module addresses were ever submitted, 4 have since expired. checkValidModule() = true today for exactly these five adapters: 0xfb46481a9819e068af0eb64a2c2824fcecaaaa45, 0x8f36bbee57acb4857cb97898020b529969fdf221, 0x77cbb2f180f55dd2916bfc78f879a2c2de37f638, 0x5febefd5aecfefb3352c5edd49d634b1456c4bd7, 0x397fb4a34757ac180c0841b26131f25040e2e50b. 0xfb46481a… has a never-expiring module grant (expiredAt = 2^256-1); the other four expire 2027-10 (modules() reads). All approvals were submitted by the curator DAO proxy 0x9fe66037c44236c87d9ac8345f489b4413fdff06.

controls.label: USDU DAO / curator (adapter whitelist authority)
controls.evidence: curator() on the USDU token returns this ERC1967Proxy (the curator DAO, implementation behind the proxy), read 2026-07-20. It is the sole submitter of all historical SetModule events and governs adapter approval and risk parameters.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203 the USDU token's curator/guardian/module model was established (curator = 0x9fe66037c44236c87d9ac8345f489b4413fdff06, no guardian set, mintModule/burnModule gated to whitelisted modules). 2026-07-20 follow-up: full SetModule/SubmitModule event enumeration from block 0 found 9 historical module approvals, of which exactly five are currently valid (checkValidModule = true): 0xfb46481a9819e068af0eb64a2c2824fcecaaaa45, 0x8f36bbee57acb4857cb97898020b529969fdf221, 0x77cbb2f180f55dd2916bfc78f879a2c2de37f638, 0x5febefd5aecfefb3352c5edd49d634b1456c4bd7, 0x397fb4a34757ac180c0841b26131f25040e2e50b. The curator DAO proxy resolves to a standard Aragon OSx DAO implementation (0x58c1f7bc62bb63fb137bc8f6d8ea6321a0501d29): module approvals execute through the Aragon permission framework rather than a single EOA.
